newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK Nov exports down 4.6 pct, re-exports up 9.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK Nov exports down 4.6 pct, re-exports up 9.1 pct.

text.p: The volume of Hong Kong's domestic exports in November fell 4.6 percent on the year, while re-exports rose 9.1 percent, the Census and Statistics Department said on Tuesday.
Total export volume rose 6.8 percent and import volume was up 7.1 percent, it said.
The volume of domestic exports for the first 11 months of 1996 decreased by 8.2 percent, but the volume of re-exports leapt 7.7 percent.
Total exports rose 5.0 percent and imports grew by 4.3 percent during the 11 months.
Prices of domestic exports decreased by 0.3 percent in November 1996 from a year earlier and re-export prices fell 1.2 percent. Import prices decreased by 2.1 percent.
Prices of domestic exports for the first 11 months of 1996 were 0.4 percent higher, while those of re-exports were down 0.4 percent. Import prices fell 1.4 percent.

Prices are based on unit values which do not take into account changes in the composition or quality of goods traded, except for some selected commodities for which specific price indices are available, the department said.
